name: wmtiles
description: Pure-TypeScript reader plus WebGL2 renderers (heatmap, animated particles, vector arrows, isobars) and optional Leaflet/MapLibre adapters for the WMTiles single-file weather data format. Reader runs in browsers, Node, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers; renderers need a WebGL2 canvas.
author: hstin

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/format.ts --outfile dist/format.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/decoder.ts --outfile dist/decoder.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/tileid.ts --outfile dist/tileid.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/errors.ts --outfile dist/errors.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/render/heatmap.ts --outfile dist/render/heatmap.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/particles.ts --outfile dist/render/particles.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/isobar.ts --outfile dist/render/isobar.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/arrows.ts --outfile dist/render/arrows.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/symbols.ts --outfile dist/render/symbols.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/hatch.ts --outfile dist/render/hatch.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/source.ts --outfile dist/render/source.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/render/colormap.ts --outfile dist/render/colormap.cjs --target browser --format cjs && bun build src/adapters/leaflet.ts --outfile dist/adapters/leaflet.cjs --target browser --format cjs --external leaflet && bun build src/adapters/maplibre.ts --outfile dist/adapters/maplibre.cjs --target browser --format cjs --external maplibre-gl
